headline: Bank of Japan Updates Quarterly JGB Outright Purchase Schedule
summary: The Bank of Japan released updated quarterly schedules for its outright purchases of Japanese government bonds conducted via competitive auction.
why: The Bank of Japan conducts regular government bond purchases to implement its monetary policy framework and manage liquidity in the Japanese sovereign debt market.

impacts.name: Japan 10-year government bond yield
impacts.why: Bank of Japan bond purchase operations directly influence domestic government bond pricing and market liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
